messages.content:
Book: he placed the little pig inside his funnel-shaped hat
Where was it put?
In his funnel-shaped hat.

Book: placed them carefully in his inside pocket
Where was it put?
In his inside pocket.

Book: He drew from his inside pocket one of the eight tiny piglets
Where was it put?
Not enough evidence.

Book: climbed down the sides of this house to the ground
Which direction did they go?
Down.

Book: creeping slowly up another steep incline
Which direction did they go?
Up.

Book: they did not like the darkness or the damp smell
Which direction did they go?
Not enough evidence.

Book: At three o'clock the Throne Room was crowded with citizens
When did this happen?
At three o'clock.

Book: as soon as it was daylight, he resolved to take a walk
When did this happen?
At daybreak.

Book: the citizens crowded into the great Throne Room
When did this happen?
Not enough evidence.

Book: falling so slowly that we can't be dashed to pieces
Why did they feel safe?
They fell slowly.

Book: difficult for them to fly amongst these rocks
Why did they feel safe?
The rocks made flying hard.

Book: The boy became silent, having no reply
Why did they feel safe?
Not enough evidence.

Book: Jim slowly trotted into the courtyard
How fast did the animal move?
Slowly.

Book: scampered along the ground like a streak
How fast did the animal move?
Very fast.

Book: the kitten was no place to be seen
How fast did the animal move?
Not enough evidence.

Book: with a green marble floor and carved marble wainscoting
What material is described?
Green marble.

Book: made all of burnished copper
What material is described?
Burnished copper.

Book: Jim accepted it as a mere detail
What material is described?
Not enough evidence.

Book: Jim's ears were standing erect
What body part is described?
His ears.

Book: arms extraordinarily long and stout
What body part is described?
Arms.

Book: a man standing on the floor in the center
What body part is described?
Not enough evidence.

Book: out of this place before the mother dragon comes back
What was proposed?
Leave before she returns.

Book: proposed a race between the Sawhorse and the Cab-horse
What was proposed?
Race the two horses.

Book: the others were delighted at the suggestion
What was proposed?
Not enough evidence.
